## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? What are you trying to do that AutoEdit
doesn't currently support?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or change you'd like to see.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches or workarounds you've tried.

## Fits the project philosophy?

AutoEdit is intentionally a single dependency-free script (see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#project-philosophy)) — `faster-whisper` is the
only optional dependency, and there's no GPU requirement. Please note whether your
request would require adding a new required dependency or a GPU, and why it's worth it.

## Additional context

Anything else relevant (mockups, example commands, links to similar tools).
